mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS decline are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% in the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakness in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 2.0% and sustained for 3 months), the increased cost of borrowing reduces corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances during tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index base 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500.0 (thousands of units) signals weak consumer confidence and reduced construction activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS decline are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a sharp deterioration in labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
